## What can the reader build?

Describe the outcome and the input needed. Include a preview for a new recipe or a changed generation workflow.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran publishing validation, Python tests, TypeScript tests, and type checks.
- [ ] Checked metadata, source links, input provenance, and preview assets.
- [ ] Kept Python and TypeScript request payloads equivalent.
- [ ] Documented cost, limitations, model information, and the actual verification date.
- [ ] Kept keys, private inputs, runtime outputs, and temporary task URLs out of the change.

If live generation was performed, state its approved cost and observed result. Otherwise say that validation used offline checks and existing sample artifacts.
